import_rules: Transcribe an explicit formula or an individually enumerated substitution, retaining the source spelling and exact locator; never expand an unspecified range into samples.

Require explicit successful synthesis and an actual superconductivity measurement. Failed synthesis, unsuccessful carrier injection, absent literature and DFT-only candidates are not experimental negatives.

Store the lowest measured temperature, pressure, applied field, sample form, doping/stoichiometry, phase and measurement criterion. Unknown values stay null with a reason; they are not replaced by ambient conditions.
No observed transition down to Tmin is censored evidence, not Tc=0. Binary training requires an explicit threshold no lower than Tmin and matching conditions.
A null at one composition or in an undoped parent cannot label the parent as lacking potential under every doping or pressure. These records are never fed to Hurricane 6's parent-potential target.

Before any training use, check exact-sample positive conflicts at the same conditions, retain source/condition-specific records, and assign train/test groups by chemical system so the same material cannot leak across splits.
Preserve the raw extraction separately; a second source check is needed before table-image transcription can be promoted to source_checked.
